title: OPENASP: A Benchmark for Multi-document Open Aspect-based Summarization
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It is a general-purpose benchmark for multi-document open aspect-based summarization on news topics.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the research. The only mention of religious context is in the 'Ethics and Broader Impact' section, where the authors discuss the October 7, 2023 terrorist attack by Hamas on Israel, which is separate from the paper's core research findings.
